description: This file defines the internal class 'CancellationSourcesExtension' which manages cancellation token sources associated with grain activations in Orleans runtime. It handles registration, cancellation, expiration, and disposal of cancellation tokens, and includes logging for cancellation failures.

classes.name: CancellationSourcesExtension
classes.description: Manages cancellation tokens for grain activation, including registration, cancellation, expiration, and cleanup.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: Represents a cancellation token entry with timestamp for expiration management.

methods.name: CancellationSourcesExtension
methods.description: Constructor initializing the extension with logger factory and cancellation runtime.

methods.name: CancelRemoteToken
methods.description: Cancels a remote token by its ID, logs failure if not found.

methods.name: RegisterCancellationTokens
methods.description: Registers cancellation tokens from a request into the extension.

methods.name: RecordCancellationToken
methods.description: Records or retrieves a cancellation token by ID, optionally cancels if requested.

methods.name: ExpireTokens
methods.description: Removes expired tokens based on timestamp.

methods.name: Touch
methods.description: Updates the timestamp of the token entry.

methods.name: IsExpired
methods.description: Checks if the token has expired based on the timestamp.

methods.name: LogCancellationFailed
methods.description: Logs a warning when a cancellation request fails because the token was not found.
